title: T-Mobile's Customer Controversy

scenes.text: Did T-Mobile just rip off millions with surprise billing?
Recent reports indicate T-Mobile raised prices for 8 million users unexpectedly.
Customers complain of being switched to new plans without consent.
Are companies prioritizing profits over customer trust?
